states.name: idle
states.action: smooth 8-frame fighting stance idle loop: frame 1 neutral guard, frames 2-4 gentle chest rise and slight knee bounce with fists bobbing, frame 5 peak of breath, frames 6-8 smooth return to neutral guard
requirements: all 8 frames in one single horizontal row from left to right with equal spacing
keep the guard stance and facing right in every frame
feet stay planted on the same ground line
frame 8 flows smoothly back into frame 1 for a seamless loop

states.name: walk
states.action: smooth 8-frame side-view walk cycle loop in place: frames 1-2 right leg steps forward and takes weight, frames 3-4 legs pass at mid-stride as body rises slightly, frames 5-6 left leg steps forward and takes weight, frames 7-8 legs pass at mid-stride returning to frame 1
requirements: all 8 frames in one single horizontal row from left to right with equal spacing
clear smooth progression of leg and arm swing across all 8 frames
the body height, head size, hip height and ground line must be identical in all 8 frames
the character walks in place facing right, skirt and twin-tail hair sway smoothly
frame 8 flows seamlessly back into frame 1

states.name: crouch
states.action: smooth 8-frame crouching guard animation: frames 1-2 bending knees into low crouch, frames 3-6 low crouched fighting guard with subtle breathing and twin-tails resting low, frames 7-8 holding low guard ready to spring
requirements: all 8 frames in one single horizontal row from left to right with equal spacing
same facing right and same ground line
body clearly lower than the idle stance
no attack, no jump

states.name: jump
states.action: smooth 8-frame jump and airborne arc: frame 1 knee bend launch, frames 2-3 rising upward with legs tucked slightly, frames 4-5 apex hover in mid-air, frames 6-7 descending with skirt and twin-tails floating upward, frame 8 preparing to land
requirements: all 8 frames in one single horizontal row from left to right with equal spacing
keep the body the same proportions and head size as the idle pose
no ground line, no shadow, no dust

states.name: attack-light
states.action: smooth 8-frame fast jab combo punch with lead arm: frame 1 guard, frame 2 shoulder pull-back wind-up, frame 3 arm snapping forward half-way, frames 4-5 full crisp horizontal punch extension at shoulder height, frames 6-7 crisp retraction, frame 8 back to fighting stance
requirements: all 8 frames in one single horizontal row from left to right with equal spacing
frames 4 and 5 show the fist fully extended forward at shoulder height
feet stay planted on the same ground line in every frame
no impact effects, no motion lines

states.name: attack-heavy
states.action: smooth 8-frame heavy straight power punch: frames 1-2 deep torso twist and rear arm wind-up behind shoulder, frame 3 explosive forward lunge torso rotation, frames 4-5 full extended heavy power punch with forward shoulder drive, frames 6-7 follow-through recovery, frame 8 return to guard
requirements: all 8 frames in one single horizontal row from left to right with equal spacing
the striking fist reaches maximum forward extension on frames 4 and 5
the body axis and both feet stay on the same ground line in every frame
no impact effects, no motion lines, no comic symbols

states.name: kick
states.action: smooth 8-frame high side kick: frame 1 weight shift to support leg, frame 2 knee chambered high at waist, frame 3 leg snapping out, frames 4-5 full high kick extension forward with toe pointed, frames 6-7 rechambering knee and lowering leg, frame 8 foot planted back in stance
requirements: all 8 frames in one single horizontal row from left to right with equal spacing
the kicking foot is furthest forward on frames 4 and 5
the supporting foot stays on the same ground line in every frame
no impact effects, no motion lines

states.name: hurt
states.action: smooth 8-frame hit stagger reaction: frame 1 impact jolt, frames 2-4 head and upper torso recoiling backward with arms flung wide, frames 5-6 peak recoil stagger, frames 7-8 regaining balance back toward guard
requirements: all 8 frames in one single horizontal row from left to right with equal spacing
same facing right, feet near the same ground line
no blood, no impact sparks, no detached effects

states.name: super-cast
states.action: smooth 8-frame magical idol super move summoning sequence: gathering energy at chest, raising star wand high toward the sky, summoning candy rain, returning to stance
requirements: all 8 frames in one single horizontal row from left to right with equal spacing
feet stay planted on the same ground line
